 CORAM :
PRAVIN S. PATIL, J.
DATE : OCTOBER 08, 2025.
JUDGMENT .

By the present Appeal, the Appellants are challenging the Judgment and Order dated 23/11/2016 passed by the learned Jt. Civil Judge Senior Division, Darwha, District Yavatmal in Land Acquisition Case No. 666/2004 (Old LAC No.25/1996).
2. It is the submission of the Appellants that open land belonging to the Appellants having House No. 173 total area 74 square meters, out of which, built up area 71.45 square meters situated at Mouza Mokh, Tahsil Digras, District Yavatmal was acquired by the Respondents for submergence of Arunavati Project.

entities.text: Civil Judge Senior Division, Darwha, District Yavatmal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further stated that Notification under Section 4 of the 3/6 11.Judg.fa.166.2018.odt Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was issued on 8/6/1989.

The Special Land Acquisition Officer has passed the Award dated 26/3/1991 and granted compensation at the rate of Rs.14/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.292/- per square meter for constructed area.
3. The Appellants, being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, preferred the reference proceeding before the learned Reference Court.
In the reference proceeding, the learned Reference Court has examined the Valuer Thakurdas Boob (PW-2) at Exhibit-32.

In his evidence he deposed that he prepared the Valuation Report (Exhibit-33) and has determined the valuation of construction at the rate of Rs.700/- per square meter and Rs.40/- per square meter for open plot.

As such, on the basis of this evidence on record,
the Appellants were expecting the enhancement of the compensation as claimed in the reference proceeding.

4. According to the Appellants, without considering this specific evidence brought on record, the learned Reference Court has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs.40/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.700/- per square meter towards constructed area.
Hence, the present Appeal is Devrao Narayanrao Vilyatkar And Others vs The State Of Maharashtra, Thr. ...

2 preferred before this Court for enhancement of the compensation.
The learned Counsel for Respondent No. 4 vehemently opposed the Appeal.

It is his contention that the evidence produced on record by the Appellants was not upto the satisfaction to conclude that Appellants are entitled for higher compensation as claimed by the Appellants in the matter.

According to him, compensation awarded by the learned Reference Court is just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, and therefore, no indulgence of this Court is required in the matter.
6.

In support of their submission, Appellants have relied upon the Judgment delivered by this Court in First Appeal No.167/2018 (Bhausaheb Balabhau Wankhade (dead) through L.Rs. V/s The State of Maharashtra & Ors.).

entities.text: L.Rs. V/s The State of Maharashtra & Ors.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said Appeal was also arising out of the same acquisition proceeding of the village Mokh, Tahsil Digras, District Yavatmal.

This Court, after considering the relevant decision of the Co-ordinate Bench and the factual aspects involved in the matter, held that the Claimant therein is entitled for the compensation at the rate of Rs.100/- per square meter towards open plot and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area.

7. In the background of abovesaid factual position, as this Court has already taken a view in identical matter arising out of the same acquisition proceeding, I do not think it necessary to take any other view.
According to me, 5/6 11.Judg.fa.166.2018.odt the Judgment delivered in First Appeal No.167/2018 is squarely applicable to the facts and circumstances of the present case.
Hence, I proceed to pass following order.
ORDER 1.
The First Appeal is allowed.

2. The Judgment and Order dated 23/11/2016 passed by the learned Jt. Civil Judge Senior Division,
Darwha, District Yavatmal in Land Acquisition Case No. 666/2004 (Old LAC No.25/1996) is hereby modified to the extent that the Appellants are entitled for compensation at the rate of Rs.100/- per square meter towards open land and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area of the property of the Appellants, which is acquired in the matter.
